items.description: The largest island in Mexico, located in the Gulf of California and managed by the Seri people.
An uninhabited island group near Puerto Vallarta, famous for their unique hidden beach.
A small, protected island north of Isla Mujeres, renowned as a bird sanctuary.
Expansive blue agave fields in Jalisco, a region essential for the production of authentic tequila.
The center of Mexico's wine production, featuring numerous vineyards and beautiful mountain views.
High-altitude regions in Veracruz known for producing high-quality Mexican coffee beans.
Traditional coffee plantations nestled in the mountainous regions of Chiapas, producing prized beans.
Fields in Oaxaca where various agave species are harvested for traditional mezcal production.
Vast orchards in Michoacan that make the state the world's leading producer of avocados.
Extensive fruit orchards in Sinaloa, a major region for tropical fruit exports like mangoes.
